id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_060.pack|cs_: "Tch, what a loud brat. It's your fault for being a shrimp!
"Huh?! What are you saying, you muscle-head! You bumped into me! Can't you even say sorry?!
"Tch! Quite a mouth on you, kid! The drawing ended in the worst result for me and I'm in a foul mood!
"Taking it out on a child, at your age? It's unsightly, Underdigger.
"Just because the draw didn't go your way doesn't mean you can take it out on a kid. It's pathetic.
"No matter who your partner is, a fighter gives it everything. Right?
"Y-yeah, you're right. If you, the champion, say so...
"Heh. Sorry about that, little lady. I'll be on my way...
"Hey, partner. So she's an acquaintance of yours.
"As you can see, the little lady is unharmed. I'm glad nothing happened.
"Well then, the kids are waiting hungry, so I'll be going. Let's win the tourney that starts tomorrow!
"Oh, right! Before tomorrow's match, I'll come pick you up at the inn, so get a good night's sleep and be in top shape!
